messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate (hosted-us-west). p95 latency jumped to 2.1s, p99 to 5.2s, 5xx rate 4.3% (baseline 0.1%). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/hosts/us-west/requests

maria: @ops_oncall oncall? seeing this on the prod board, started ~7387654200 (after canary).

jonah: oncall here. I see the canary (release/2026-03-17-canary-42) deployed ~7387654000. Rolling p95 up immediately after.

ops_oncall: confirm priority page. tagging SRE lead, moving to incident channel. Customers: some streaming customers reporting stalls and 504s.

tera: quick ask — is this CPU or network? traces show request queuing at the gateway and a lot of backend upcalls timing out. Likely head-of-line blocking in runtime when tokenization spikes.

maria: kcache/kvcache eviction also spiking (evictions/sec x10). Could be a model binary change that increased mem working set. Canary included a new quantization kernel.

jonah: agree. rolling rollback to previous canary now. running: 
```bash
rwinfctl rollout cancel --service inference-hosted --release release/2026-03-17-canary-42 --force
```

ops_oncall: noted. redirecting 20% of traffic to dedicated pool as quick circuit: 
```bash
rwinfctl traffic shift --service inference-hosted --from canary-42 --to dedicated-pool-a --percent 20 --policy route-by-latency
```

sre-bot: STATUS: rollback started by jonah at 7387654260. Traffic shift initiated by ops_oncall at 7387654275.

tera: observing immediate drop in p95 from 2.1s -> 1.1s where shifted, p99 still around 3.8s. Backend 504s down 60% in shifted paths. Good signal.

emily: can ops_oncall capture customer impact note for comms? need rough ETA for full remediation and if we need to engage CSE for high-touch customers.

ops_oncall: initial estimate: if rollback completes cleanly (1-2m), we should see full recovery within 5-10m as KV caches warm. I'll collect list of impacted orgs and error windows.

jonah: rollback finished at 7387654320. running smoke checks now. 

maria: smoke: p95 back to 160ms, p99 420ms, 5xx now 0.12%. traces look clean for the previous binary. I recommend keeping canary-42 blocked from rollout pending root cause.

tera: capturing artifacts: stack traces, kernel perf counters, kvcache eviction logs attached to incident. Suggest disabling quant kernel path for next canary and re-run load test.

emily: noted for comms. drafting incident stub: "deploy -> quant-kernel -> increased mem working set -> kvcache eviction -> head-of-line timeouts -> rollback". Will refine after RCA.

ops_oncall: handoff to night oncall @jonah in 30m. status: degraded -> mitigated. Pager duty: acknowledge. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. ticket: INC-7387 created, logs uploaded to https://logs.redwood.ai/7387. Next: postmortem + retention of canary artifacts.

jonah: leaving notes in the deploy runbook: block quant-kernel flag until perf tests pass. Will follow up with model-ops to reproduce locally on sim cluster.

maria: thanks all. if metrics re-spike ping this thread and we re-open. :heart:
